card.name: Space before a number of hours
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number that will be followed by hours or a similar time unit, such as after "at least", "every", or "1 hour before or". It appears in dosing-schedule and timing text.

modes.label: Space before hour count
modes.description: The blank space just before a number that gives a time interval in hours.
modes.example: Take the starting dose on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before or<< >>2 hours after food.

modes.label: Linking word before interval
modes.description: Words like "every" or "orally" that lead into a frequency or interval.
modes.example: theophylline (200 mg<< every>> 6 hours) for 5 days

card.writes: It seems to push toward a number and time unit, and away from words about meetings or weekly schedules.
card.plain: It lights up just before the number of hours in a dosing interval, such as 'every 8 hours' or 'at least 12 hours before'.
